_comment: Custom arena maps for the stream, fetched by infra/fetch-maps.ps1 from GameBanana. Only the
Counter-Strike 1.6 upload counts: the same map name exists for CS2D, CS:S and CS:GO, so `mod` is
what pins the right one (game row 4254).
`sha256` is the pin of the archive GameBanana serves: the fetcher refuses a file whose hash does
not match, so a silently re-uploaded map fails instead of landing in the game. An empty pin means
the file has not been reviewed yet - run the fetcher with -Pin once to record it.

maps.name: fy_iceworld
maps.note: two rooms, spawns a knife throw apart

maps.name: fy_pool_day
maps.note: open middle, contact in the first second

maps.name: fy_snow
maps.note: white arena around one central tower
